# Daily Briefing – Thursday 19 November

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 5,069 steps, which is fairly sedentary. You burned 2,373 kcal though, sitting nicely around your target. The main concern is sleep at only 5.8 hours; that's the number to watch.

The good news is your recovery markers look solid despite the short night. HRV at 92ms sits within your 90–120ms baseline, and a resting HR of 53 bpm is excellent. Stress at 36/100 is low. Your body handled yesterday well — go ahead with today's planned session as normal, no need to hold back.

That 5.8 hours of sleep is the one thing worth addressing today. Aim for 7.5–8 hours tonight — poor sleep blunts protein synthesis, so even hitting your 175g protein target won't land as effectively if you're under-recovered. Prioritise the wind-down early.
